definition.objective: Transfer the retained package into the bowl and release it without displacing or overturning the bowl.

definition.handoff_requirements: Establish package-to-opening fit and relevant motion clearance from current RGB-D evidence; obtain an alternate attainable view if occlusion prevents assessment. Provide post-release observations and the actual gripper and object state.
definition.replan_conditions: Retention is lost, fit or clearance remains unresolved, the bowl moves, or the package lands outside or on the rim. Reassess from fresh observations without repeating a completed pickup or release.
